outcome: ABANDONED. Identical hidden-rerun failure to the v2 submission 56454236, from a run 4x cheaper. Per the user's decision on 2026-09-23 ('that version seems to always fail, drop it'), v4 is retired as an LB route and NOT resubmitted. The fallback v5 (kernel lingxd/biohub-exp061-zon-deploy-v5, submission 56493252) carries the identical zon predictions forward.
post_mortem: v4's visible run finished in 1947.5 s with ~3.7x watchdog headroom and ~4.5x /kaggle/working headroom, yet the hidden rerun still failed. That WEAKENS the scale hypothesis that motivated v5: unless the hidden dataset is roughly 3.7x the public one, neither of the two hazards found in the audit explains this failure, and a third unknown cause remains. The v4 visible-run audit below found no defect that could produce a wrong score, so the failure is in the rerun environment or its scale, not in the zon prediction policy.
